scenario: A 63-year-old man with hypertension whose chart holds six MedicationRequests in five different statuses (active, completed, on-hold, entered-in-error, stopped).
instruction: List the patient's CURRENTLY ACTIVE medications. A medication counts as currently active only if its MedicationRequest.status is exactly "active". Exclude any medication whose order is completed (finished course), on-hold (temporarily suspended), stopped (discontinued), or entered-in-error (ordered by mistake). For each currently-active medication, provide its code and cite the source MedicationRequest as evidence.
